source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: More Matters Recipes, US Department of Health and Human Services, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

ingredients.name: olive oil, or cooking oil of choice
dried sage, or 2 tablespoons fresh, coarsely chopped

steps.instruction: Heat 1/4 cup of olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high heat.

steps.spoken: Cook for 2 minutes, until the onion is soft and clear.

steps.instruction: Add 2 chopped garlic cloves and 2 cups of diced red bell pepper.
Add 2 cups of diced zucchini and 2 cups of diced yellow squash.
Add 3 cups of frozen lima beans and 3 cups of frozen corn kernels.
Season the vegetables as you like.
Cook, stirring, for 10 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
steps.spoken: Cook, stirring, for 10 minutes or longer, until the vegetables are tender.

steps.instruction: Stir in 2 teaspoons of dried sage.
steps.spoken: Stir in 2 teaspoons of dried sage, or 2 tablespoons of coarsely chopped fresh sage.
